name: AppWorld
description: A controllable execution environment simulating 9 day-to-day applications (email, messaging, calendar, music, etc.) with 457 APIs and approximately 100 simulated users. The benchmark contains 750 diverse agent tasks requiring multi-step interactive code generation to fulfill complex user requests within this simulated digital world. GPT-4o solves only ~49% of normal-difficulty tasks.
evaluation_method: task success rate (code execution verified against expected state)
typical_sota_score: ~49–65% on normal tasks (GPT-4o ~49%; frontier models as of 2025)
reputation: Won Best Resource Paper at ACL 2024; active leaderboard at appworld.dev; one of the most realistic multi-app agent evaluation environments; widely cited in agent research
notes: Won Best Resource Paper at ACL 2024. Simulates a realistic digital ecosystem with 9 apps (Amazon, Spotify, Venmo, WhatsApp, etc.), 457 APIs, and ~100 simulated users with histories. Tasks require reading documentation, planning multi-step API calls, and error recovery. Harder tasks require managing cross-app state. Active leaderboard at appworld.dev.
